passages.provision_quote: Any sentence enhancement that was imposed prior to January 1, 2018, pursuant to Section 11370.2 of the Health and Safety Code, except for any enhancement imposed for a prior conviction of violating or conspiring to violate Section 11380 of the Health and Safety Code is legally invalid.
passages.note: Authored bill invalidating two repealed sentence enhancements retroactively and requiring resentencing; it shortens punishment but names no treatment, service or restitution mechanism.

rows.reasoning: Allen authored SB 483 (2021-2022), which declares the listed prior sentence enhancements "legally invalid" and requires that resentencing "shall result in a lesser sentence" unless a lesser sentence would endanger public safety. That establishes a less-punitive side but matches no rung's clauses: the bill orders no "support and treatment", and no "service or restitution", and it is not "the toughest penalties the law allows". Seating a rung here would only be ruling out the other rungs, which the codebook forbids.
